title: On the Convergence of Vanilla Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise and Index Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.03201v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding how stochastic gradient noise affects the convergence of Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) is an important problem in stochastic optimization, particularly when the noise exhibits heavy-tailed behavior. In this paper, we investigate the convergence of vanilla Adam in both the expected risk and the empirical risk minimization, focusing on the effects of heavy-tailed noise and its relationship to index sampling. For the expected risk minimization, we establish convergence guarantees under H\"older smoothness and bounded $\mathfrak{p}$-th moment assumptions, allowing stochastic gradient noise with infinite variance. Our analysis provides explicit upper bounds on the expected squared gradient norm and shows that the iteration-dependent convergence term decays more slowly as $\mathfrak{p}$ decreases. translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.03201v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：理解随机梯度噪声如何影响自适应矩估计（Adam）的收敛性是随机优化中的一个重要问题，尤其是当噪声表现出重尾特性时。在本文中，我们研究了原始Adam算法在期望风险最小化和经验风险最小化两种设定下的收敛性，重点关注重尾噪声的影响及其与索引采样之间的关系。对于期望风险最小化，我们在Hölder光滑性和有界 $\mathfrak{p}$ 阶矩假设下建立了收敛性保证，允许随机梯度噪声具有无限方差。我们的分析给出了期望梯度范数平方的显式上界，并表明随着 $\mathfrak{p}$ 的减小，与迭代次数相关的收敛项衰减得更慢。对于经验风险最小化，我们建立了渐近与非渐近的收敛性保证，并证明了……
tldr: 本文研究了原始Adam算法在重尾噪声（甚至允许无限方差）和索引采样下的收敛性，在期望风险最小化和经验风险最小化两种设定下均建立了收敛性保证，并刻画了矩阶数 $\mathfrak{p}$ 对收敛速率的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes convergence guarantees for vanilla Adam under heavy-tailed noise (allowing infinite variance) and index sampling, in both expected risk and empirical risk minimization settings, characterizing how the moment order affects the convergence rate.
